content: Check for no data received from COM where E2E transformation is configured The Rte Read Api ( Rte_Read ) shall return RTE_E_NO_NEW_DATA if: • RteComDataE2EXfOverSamplingPeriod is configured. AND • returnNoNewDataEnabled is set to TRUE. AND • E2E transformation is configured for this data. AND • Last execution of RTE cycle function Rte_ComDataMainFunction before this Rte_Read call didn’t receive new data from COM within the configured RteCom- DataE2EXfOverSamplingPeriod .
